newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Securities Finance to buy margin loans on Wed.
newsitem.headline: Thai Securities Finance to buy margin loans on Wed.

text.p: Thailand Securities Finance Corp (TSFC) said on Monday it could start buying equity margin loan accounts from brokers as part of government measures to inject liquidity into the cash-strapped finance sector.

TSFC Managing Director Akarat na Ranong said his firm, partly owned by the government and the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET), would borrow up to five billion baht ($192 million) from the Government Savings Bank and the SET as its capital for refinancing the margin loans.

He said TSFC would accept about 110 liquid Thai stocks, government and state enterprise bonds as collateral for its loans to refinance unserviced margin loan accounts which grew in number because of the Thai bourse's prolonged bearishness.
